newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguan police execute monkey that mutilated child.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguan police execute monkey that mutilated child.

text.p: Nicaraguan health authorities have put to death a pet monkey that savagely attacked and disfigured a 6-month-old child, a local newspaper reported on Monday.

Juvelca Yaosca Triguero remained in stable condition in a Managua hospital after her grandmother's monkey freed itself from its leash late on Friday and attacked the child with its teeth and claws, mutilating her face and leaving her unconscious, El Nuevo Diario said.
Neighbours, police, firefighters and health officials hunted down the agile monkey, finally catching it on Sunday when it fell off the roof of a two-story house onto a patio.
Health Ministry officials gave the animal a lethal injection and the father cut off its head with a machete. The head will be tested for rabies.
